name: New Super Mario Lost Worlds
author: Nin0, Baddy, Mihi, Bestimum, LiQ, RedStoneMatt, Grop, Asu-chan
description: New Super Mario Lost Worlds (NSMLW) is a NSMBW mod with 12 new worlds. It will have custom 3d world maps as well as new enemies, boss fights and 7 custom powerups among many other things.

metadata.found_by: G-c.7 discovery (GitHub). The playable files are in a private repository; the public one has the source code and tools only (D-o.5 Reply 37).
